title: QUIC RFC 9000 IANA Provisional Registration Policy Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9000 Section 22.1.1 provisional-registration policy proof gap with a narrow internal policy model and focused requirement-home tests.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal immutable IANA registration policy model for common QUIC registry fields, provisional request requirements, provisional entry requirements, provisional field omission, review policy, date-update review policy, and status text.
- Correct the S22P1P1-0001 canonical requirement wording so it matches the RFC's request-minimum meaning instead of overconstraining stored provisional entries.
- Replace the empty S22P1P1 requirement-home scaffolds with focused positive tests for all 14 requirements.
- Add dedicated architecture, work-item, and verification trace ownership for the S22P1P1 provisional-registration policy family.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S22P1P1 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Packet, frame, or transport-parameter parser and serializer behavior.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused policy-model and requirement-home proof for the S22P1P1 provisional-registration family.
